summary: Learn chart selection, infographic layout and accessible data reporting with Excel and PowerPoint. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Infographic data analysis and reporting helps analysts, communications officers and reporting specialists turn analyzed figures into clear visual reports. Learners practise selecting charts for comparisons and trends, checking percentage and percentage-point changes, adding source notes and annotations, and reviewing accessibility before preparing infographic layouts in Excel and PowerPoint.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, review or explain data graphics in operational reports, presentations and public-facing information. It is designed for foundation-level learners who need a repeatable way to move from analyzed figures to clear infographic outputs.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with spreadsheets and workplace reports is expected. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use Excel and PowerPoint, so access to both applications on a laptop is needed.
